description: Common hobby/robotics servos. null = not stated by any source opened; numbers are never inferred. verified=true only when the key numbers came from a manufacturer page/datasheet that was actually opened. Same-name clones (Amazon MG996R/SG90/DS3218) vary widely; the genuine manufacturer spec is recorded.

fields.dims_mm: l = case length without mounting tabs, w = width, h = case height without spline; unless notes say the source's L x W x H inclusion is unclear
fields.torque_kgcm: stall torque at the quoted voltage
fields.pulse_*_us / travel_deg: as the cited source states (Hitec/ServoCity ranges are often max travel, not the 90 deg convention)
fields.clone_of: id of the genuine servo this listing copies (per its own listing title/servodatabase), else null
fields.dtg: robo_prober.servo_db.to_dtg(entry) maps an entry to digital_twin_generator's dtg.servo-library/1 shape
